notice: Every record here is invented. No real person, account, publisher, URL, or post is reproduced. The wording is deliberately mild: these fixtures exist to prove that the pipeline preserves structure, provenance, context, and Unicode, not to demonstrate what hateful text looks like.

items.title: Council debates funding for a new community centre
items.permitted_excerpt: Councillors heard submissions on a proposed community centre. Several faith groups spoke in favour.
items.original_text: Councillors heard submissions on a proposed community centre. Several faith groups spoke in favour, and the vote was deferred to next month.

items.title: Police report a rise in recorded religious hate crime
items.permitted_excerpt: Newly published figures show an increase in recorded offences with a religious aggravating factor.
items.original_text: Newly published figures show an increase in recorded offences with a religious aggravating factor. Researchers cautioned that reporting rates and recording practice both changed during the period.

items.title: Researchers publish a method for monitoring online religious hostility
items.permitted_excerpt: The paper describes a sampling frame and its limitations, and warns against reading a monitored sample as a population estimate.
items.original_text: The paper describes a sampling frame and its limitations, and warns against reading a monitored sample as a population estimate.
